items.effect: lost: not imported (the PPTX reader does not read this yet)
items.label: chart(s)

items.effect: approximated: its text styles are the base of the notes text; the notes page layout (slide image, header, footer, date, page number placeholders and the master's own theme) is not kept
items.label: notes master(s)

items.effect: lost: not imported (the PPTX reader does not read this yet)
items.label: shape(s) or run(s) with shadow, glow, reflection or soft edges

items.effect: approximated: imported as a gradient; a gradient taken from the theme's style list (not the shape's own fill) is read as a solid colour
items.label: gradient fill(s)

items.effect: kept: the deck keeps its own slide size
items.label: slide size other than 16:9

items.effect: kept: spans are stored on the origin cell and the cells it covers are marked
items.label: merged table cell(s)

items.effect: approximated: the stored font scale and line spacing reduction are applied as written; line breaks may differ from PowerPoint
items.label: text box(es) that shrink or resize to fit their text

items.effect: approximated: bullet character, colour, size and numbering are kept; bullet fonts and numbering schemes beyond arabic, alpha and roman are not
items.label: paragraph(s) with custom bullets or numbering

items.effect: approximated: tab stops are kept, but the editor lays out default tabs
items.label: paragraph(s) with tab stops

items.effect: lost: not imported (the PPTX reader does not read this yet)
items.label: slide(s) with a transition
